commons.title: Isaac Herzog at the inauguration of the first Hall of Culture in the city of Rahat, February 2022 (KBG GPO1299).jpg
commons.description: The President of Israel, Isaac Herzog, at the inauguration of the first Hall of Culture in the city of Rahat. The inauguration of the hall took place in the presence of Deputy Minister of Internal Security MK Yoav Saglovitz, MK Mansour Abbas, Mifal HaPais chairman Avigdor Yitzhaki and Rahat Mayor Faiz Abu Sahiban. The new hall is the first cultural hall established in Bedouin society and one of the largest halls in the Negev. After the solemn Hanukkah ceremony, the President met with the members of the Jewish-Bedouin association "Stars of the Desert." Tuesday, April 15, 2022. Photo credit: Kobi Gideon / GPO.
commons.source_category: Wikipedia article: Arab citizens of Israel
commons.editorial_reason: The caption specifically ties the cultural hall to Bedouin society in Rahat, and the image shows the hall's inauguration with that community present.
